body.title: ToolDenied carrier and ToolFailure mapping
body.summary: Add the ToolDenied error class (tool id, denial reason, optional partial progress, and for commit-and-push the phase, committed flag and staged paths), the isToolDenied predicate, and one mapping function from every ToolFailureKind to the old GhCommandError kinds (command timed-out to unreachable, conversion-failed and schema-mismatch to rejected and never best-effort, denied to ToolDenied). No site uses it yet.
acceptanceChecks: Every ToolFailureKind has a mapping and a test; denied maps to a thrown ToolDenied carrying the reason
conversion-failed and schema-mismatch can never produce a best-effort false, null, [] or undefined

tests.name: tool-denied.test.ts: every ToolFailureKind maps to the old kind or ToolDenied; conversion-failed and schema-mismatch never become a best-effort value
